description: Add deterministic browser noise and WAV encoding tests
notes: Added browser/runtime.mjs with documented mulberry32+Box-Muller seeded normal noise and float32 24 kHz mono WAV encoder. Chromium proof now uses seed 0 and validates RIFF/WAVE header, format, channel count, sample rate, and byte length.

description: Run corpus synthesis, parity, and offline renderer tests
notes: Ran Chromium ORT-Web synthesis for five single-chunk corpus cases; all produced finite valid WAV buffers. Evidence: fixtures/browser-corpus-results.json. The long case remains unexecuted because chunk concatenation/pause/fade runtime is not implemented. No durable CacheStorage/local asset cache offline test exists yet, so that acceptance gate remains failed.

description: Record measurements and finalize report decision
notes: Updated REPORT.md with seeded noise/WAV validation and five-case Chromium corpus timing evidence. Final decision remains NO-GO because long-text concatenation, durable offline cache replay, warm/peak-memory metrics, shared-noise numeric comparison, and manual listening evidence are absent; no claims were fabricated.
